_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: AQA A-level French (7652) specification: themes 3.1-3.2, grammar 3.3, works 3.4 and the individual research project 3.5
_items_source.version: Version 1.1 (August 2026), linked from aqa.org.uk/7652 and itemised 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: AQA numbers the themes (3.1.1-3.2.2) and grammar sections (3.3.1.1-3.3.2.2); the 36 sub-theme bullets are unnumbered, so this course codes them by sub-theme (FAM, CYB, BEN, DIV, MAR, CRI, PAT, MUS, CIN, ADO, GRE, IMM) with .1-.3 in AQA's order. Set works are coded TXT-01 to TXT-10 and FLM-01 to FLM-06 in AQA's list order; the research project is 3.5.
